## Relevant Learning Standards

6. Filter, aggregate, and transform datasets using grouping and summary operations to answer specific analytical questions. (Labs 0, 1, 2, 3)
7. Join multiple datasets using appropriate join strategies and explain how different join types affect the resulting output. (Labs 0, 2, 3)
8. Reshape data between wide and long formats to meet the requirements of different analytical or visualization tasks. (Labs 1, 3)
9. Derive new variables from existing ones through calculated transformations, including unit conversions, differences across time periods, and categorical dummy variables. (Labs 2, 3)
:::
